title: Delegaitor
tagline: Symbiosis of Human and AI for enchanced and active DAO voting. Chose strategy and delegate your voting power to AI agents
description: DAOs often struggle with slow decision-making and proposals that don't meet quorum. Using AI delegates could speed up processes and help more proposals succeed. Users can be involved in voting based on their interests, Delegaitor will create best AI strategy by surveying users and our AI agents will do the rest for you/
how_its_made: We are using React frontend with walletconnect where user can connect their wallet. User will be asked to fill out survey form to choose the most suitable AI agent voting strategy for user. User need to stake $DELEGA token for AI computation costs to be covered and then user are allowed to delegate their voting tokens to our AI agents.
